lines.en: Some people say that enduring stressful situations together is enough to make people closer. But I’m not sure who those people are because I don’t understand how or why.
Because for me, the things that remind me of what I’d rather not be reminded of sit atop the list of what I must avoid for sake of my sanity.
And if there’s a face or a smell or a voice that takes me back to any degree, even if it’s the slightest, I will cut them out without question and return to how I’ve always been.
Safe. Content. And trapped somewhere no one can hurt me unless they force their way in.
It was similar for the Kanda sisters — two girls who, while not having endured recent stressful situations together, did ultimately wind up in the same place through similar circumstances.
Each one trusted someone they shouldn’t have. And each one found themselves repeatedly dry heaving in the middle of the night when unwanted dreams wearing masks of memories crept in.

So while the scents and sounds in question would contend with the words that dotted the sky like clouds just moments ago, showing us that you don’t need to be together to be together, there was still something about the face.
The one that looked down on them — with a mask you can’t hang on your wall. The kind that changes based on who is looking at it and when. There was something about that.
And maybe it was just because they’d fall asleep under the same sky, protected by the same walls that were now being shattered by my greatest fear.
Maybe it was because of that that they didn’t technically need to endure something together but, instead, could just convince themselves they’re not alone beneath the watchful eyes of a spiteful god.
Unfortunately, however, it matters not what someone thinks so long as God is watching.
And that, sooner rather than later, they’d be pulled from home like the doll house it is to become a late night snack for someone better.
But even then, it’s better being ground into paste against the molars of a beast when someone else’s screams are present to distract you from your own.
Stay hydrated.
Stay sinless.
: You’re staring at me a lot today and I don’t like it.
: I’m just happy we started jogging together. I’d always wish you were here when I came alone.
: Why? All I do is slow you down.
: Because it’s not about speed, Kirin! Jogging’s great for when it comes to refocusing your mind and getting your priorities in order.
: And having you here makes me glad that you’re not just sitting on the couch eating sweets all morning.
: Plus — I kind of just love you. And being with people you love is something that makes everyone happy.
: Gross. You could have just said having a second set of eyes here helps protect you from voyeurs or something.
: Which, come to think of it, I’m getting bad vibes from that dude in the trench coat over there and suggest that we change our route.
: Oh, that’s just Akechi-san. He always comes here to Facetime with his daughter in the morning. I’ve had to give him directions a few times in the past. I think he might have dementia or something.
: He looks like he’s filming us.
: Are you sure? He’s probably just showing the park to his daughter.
: Sure. Or maybe his daughter is just an excuse he uses to come here and get new footage for his Karin Kanda spank bank every morning.
: Kirin, ew! He’s like eighty years old! You’re supposed to respect your elders!
: Yeah, but since when does that include letting them jerk off to secret videos they take of me from a bench in the park?
: Akechi-san’s not like that. You just think he is because you have a dirty mind and he happens to be wearing a trench coat.
: Then why is his hand down his pants right now?
: Probably because he-
: Oh no.
: You really need to stop giving creepy people the benefit of the doubt, sis. It’s this point in life that normal people start outgrowing their purity and replacing it with common sense.
: I’m starting to think all those times he dropped things while I was passing him weren’t accidental either...
: Yeah. Maybe you just shouldn’t come here anymore.
: Wanna take a break? Somewhere...on the opposite side of the park?
: Can I go snatch that old guy’s phone really quick and toss it into the fountain?
: Only if you’re sure you can make it look like an accident.
: Challenge accepted.
: So yeah, I think it’s safe to say he won’t be coming here anymore. Both literally and...I guess also literally but in a grosser way.
: I’m sorry, Kirin. If I’d known there were perverts here, I obviously would have suggested going somewhere else to jog.
: There are perverts everywhere, sis. You could be sitting next to one right now and you wouldn’t even know it.
: Except I do know it because you have gotten increasingly worse at concealing it these last few years.
: At least I’m not out in public letting senior citizens masturbate to me. For all I know, you were doing that on purpose and I just ruined all the fun.
: Kirin, we do this to refocus our minds, remember? You’re doing essentially the complete opposite of that right now.
: You do this to refocus your mind. I’ve been doing it so we can spend more time together. And also keep myself in shape, I guess.
: You...sorry, what? Could you repeat that?
: No. It was embarrassing enough the first time.
: This is the happiest day of my life. Even if I just found out someone was taking candid photos of me.
: Don’t think too much about it or it might interfere with all of that “refocusing” you’re trying to do.
: I will do literally anything to preserve this moment in time. Just say it and it shall be done.
: Don’t make it weird, please.
: That is literally the one thing I can not do. I am sorry.
: Wonderful. I should have just kept my mouth shut.
: Where did that even come from? Is everything okay? Do you need something? How can I help?
: Just doing some reflecting lately. Trying to be less...terrible and all that. And I know I’ve been sort of...unfairly taking some of my frustrations out on you for a long time.
: Kirin, I’m scared. Are you dying?
: I’m not dying! I just...don’t have time for superficial hatred anymore! And you’re the only person who’s ever on my side 100%% of the time, so...this is like an investment!
: An investment?
: Yeah! I stop being mean to you and you...make me feel good about myself or something! That’s how sibling relationships are supposed to work, right?!
: Heh...yeah. That’s one way for it to work...
: I’m sorry for...being such a bitch all the time, Karin.
: And I guess I’ll just...pre-apologize now in the event that it happens again in the future. Which it probably will since changing is way harder than I thought it would be.
: Why do you want to change at all, Kirin? Like...did something inspire this or what?
: Hah...
: You can take your time if you need to. We don’t even need to do it today. I just want to be sure you’re okay and-
: I’m...fine. It’s just, like...
: You know how when we were on the soccer team together and I couldn’t ever keep up with anybody, I always got upset about it and, like...stormed off or whatever?
: It feels like my whole life has been just...that. Watching everyone else pull ahead and lashing out because of jealousy or sadness.
: I’m just tired of it. I want something of my own now. And I keep telling myself it’s okay if someone is better than me at it, but...I can’t bring myself to actually believe it.
: So maybe I just need more positivity around me or...something. I don’t know. Noriko helps, but Noriko isn’t you.
: I guess none of it really matters, though. Even talking about it like this feels childish and I should probably just shut up if I want to seem serious about anything.
: You’re wrong.
: It’s not childish at all, Kirin. And anything you need, if it’s within my power to help you, I will.
: So if there’s ever anything in life you choose to not feel bad about, please just make it this. Chasing after happiness shouldn’t ever come with negatives like that.
: Yeah...I know. And that’s sort of exactly what I thought you’d say, so thank you.
: But you know...you can count on me too, Karin.
: I know. And I do.
: Do you, though? Because you always say that but, when push comes to shove, you’d rather face your problems alone than drag me into them.
: Well, I...uhh...there are just...certain problems you shouldn’t be dragged into. And my priority as an older sister is keeping you happy, so-
: Your priority should be yourself. It’s not fair if you’re the only one sacrificing herself for her sibling. I want to do that too. You just won’t let me.
: If it’s a trust thing, I get it. Like, I wouldn’t trust me either. But-
: It’s not like that...
: I just...
: You know how I am. How I’m...not really good when it comes to adult stuff. Like, even today — I didn’t get what was going on with Akechi-san until you blatantly pointed it out to me.
: So I just...have a hard time dealing with certain things in general. And some of those things only get harder when you’re brought into the picture, so...
: It’s not about not trusting you at all. It’s more just...needing to figure out what to do.
: I guess we’ve both got some work to do then. So here’s hoping jogging can somehow fix all of our issues.
: It won’t fix all of them, but it could help fix some. And we can help each other with the rest of them.
: Deal. Can we focus on fixing my stomach first, though? I skipped breakfast this morning since I didn’t want to eat before running and I am now paying the price for that.
: That’s fine. I’m hungry too.
: Koi Cafe isn’t far. We can-
: No. Absolutely not. Literally anywhere else is fine.
: Oh. Uhh...
: Did...did something happen...there?
: Well, uhh...not technically there but just...
: T...Take all that stuff you said about not knowing how to deal with certain things a minute ago and just copy-paste it here. Thanks.
: So...it didn’t happen there, but it’s obviously connected...
: Did...something happen with...Rin or Molly, maybe? You didn’t come home for a few days after your Christmalloween party, so if there was something that happened there-
: Just drop it, okay? You already know who I like and I don’t have any intention of doing anything romantic with anyone else. Full stop.

: Okay. But A — I didn’t mention romance. And B — I feel like, as your older sister, I should probably also use this moment to tell you that you shouldn’t be doing anything romantic with an adult either.
: Y...You liked him too until some stuff happened that you refused to ever tell me about! So don’t act like I’m the one doing something wrong just because you’re not into him anymore!
: I’m older than you, Kirin.
: By a year! So what?!
: A year and a half. But even if it was a day and a half, it wouldn’t change anything.
: What matters is that I learned firsthand just how blind I was being and that, looking back on it now, what I was feeling wasn’t romantic at all. It was immature...hormonal...confusion.
: And if I knew what Sensei was really like from the beginning, I never would have felt that way at all.
: You still feel it, you fucking liar. You’re just pretending not to because things got too real when you went out to karaoke one night and convinced yourself he actually wanted to hurt you.
: Wha...how...why do you...
: Because you’re not the only one who was there, Karin! And, spoiler alert, Sensei has a mouth too!
: So don’t give me shit about not telling you stuff when you did the same with me!
: He...told you about that?
: Not willingly. I had to fucking drag it out of him because he felt so bad about the whole ordeal that he filed it into his overflowing cabinet of other horrible repressed memories!
: But he still told you. The words came out of his mouth.
: No, I just put fucking two and two together because I’m not an innocent little girl anymore, Karin!
: I have common fucking sense! And when two people I love get into some shit together, I want to find out what it is!
: And yes! I did just say “love!” Because no matter how many times I tell myself it isn’t true or that I don’t deserve to feel this way, I love him! I love him, Karin! Love, love, love, love, love!
: You don’t, Kirin...It’s not love. It only feels like it is because he’s the only person you’ve ever felt that way about.
: So what?! If anything, I think that’s proof that it is love!

: Who gives a shit if I change my mind years down the line when all I want right now is to marry him and start a family and fucking...teach our daughters how to play soccer and go to Tokyo Disneyland and a million other things I never even dreamed of wanting before I met him!
: You’re gonna look at me and tell me that isn’t love?! What do you know?! You could be a hundred years older than me and still be wrong about this! I. LOVE. SENSEI. The end!
: He’s twice your age, Kirin! Just...please think about what you’re saying.
: You think I haven’t?! That’s why I went after him in the first place!
: I just wanted someone to distract me from how fucking sad and unwanted I’ve always felt and I figured he’d be an easy target! I didn’t expect this to happen! But it did, and now I’m happy!

: So you can either be happy for me or you can run off to Mom and Dad and burn down the first good thing I’ve ever had in my life because you think you know what’s better for me than I do! What’s it gonna be, Karin?!
: There are so many good things, Kirin...so many. All around you...You really think he is the first?
: If you want to get technical about it, fine. You were the first. And I said I love you too, didn’t I? But that just makes it even more important to me that you understand this, Karin.
: I know it’s morally fucked. And I know what happened with you guys. And yes, that makes me very mad. But it doesn’t change how I feel. It doesn’t change what I dream of.
: And it really doesn’t change how it feels when he says that he loves me.
: Did he...really tell you that?...
: Or when he kisses me...
: Kirin-
: I love him so much...
: So why...
: Why did I do that?...
The sky looks down on both sisters, now causing a scene in a local park, and it chuckles to itself — tossing javelins of light down at them and piercing their hearts as the spectacle unfolds.
Neither girl really understands, but they can feel the burn as it pierces through them.
Just one hates it.
And the other wants more.
Kirin’s affection has increased to [kirin_love]!
